claims.text: Osteoporosis treatment (postmenopausal women and men): 70 mg PO once weekly or 10 mg daily.
claims.quote: Treatment of osteoporosis in postmenopausal women and in men: 10 mg daily or 70 mg (tablet or oral solution) once weekly.

claims.text: Prevention (postmenopausal): 35 mg weekly or 5 mg daily.
claims.quote: Prevention of osteoporosis in postmenopausal women: 5 mg daily or 35 mg once weekly.

claims.text: Low fracture risk: consider stopping after 3–5 years.
claims.quote: For patients at low-risk for fracture, consider drug discontinuation after 3 to 5 years of use.

claims.text: Raloxifene: one 60 mg tablet daily, any time of day without regard to meals.
claims.quote: The recommended dosage is one 60 mg EVISTA (raloxifene hydrochloride tablets) tablet daily, which may be administered any time of day without regard to meals

claims.text: Prolia (denosumab): 60 mg SC once every 6 months.
claims.quote: The recommended dose of Prolia is 60 mg administered as a single subcutaneous injection once every 6 months.
